text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Raidramon] & [Dezipmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
